Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Source molecule_dictionary, molecule_hierarchy, compound_structures, compound_records, docs, activities, assays, target_dictionary. Join molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno to find salt forms, join compound_structures on molregno, join compound_records on molregno, join docs on doc_id, join activities on record_id, join assays on assay_id, join target_dictionary on tid. Filter parent compound chembl_id equals 'CHEMBL3182437', target chembl_id equals 'CHEMBL3430885', standard_type equals 'IC50'. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
